Underlying is six-decimal Monad USDC 0x754704Bc059F8C67012fEd69BC8A327a5aafb603; shares use underlying decimals (six here), not 18-decimal generic cToken units. Asset amounts in deposit/withdraw/borrow/repay are raw USDC atoms; mint/redeem/post/remove collateral use raw cUSDC shares. Deposits/mints/repayments require payer USDC allowance to this cToken.

Plain deposit/mint can fund any receiver without posting collateral. depositAsCollateral requires caller=receiver or an approved PositionManager; its For variant requires existing cToken delegate approval. postCollateral/removeCollateral operate on caller shares; For variants use existing delegate approval. No approval, permit or delegation-authority change is admitted.

withdraw/redeem and collateral-forcing variants burn owner shares and pay explicit receiver; non-owner calls need share allowance. redeemFor/redeemCollateralFor instead require existing delegate approval. Collateral variants force reduction of posted shares; plain exits may still remove collateral when required by balance accounting. Collateral/debt health, oracle checks and current market caps remain authoritative; posting collateral cannot be used while this account has debt in this same cToken, and borrowing cannot be used while it has collateral posted in this same cToken.

borrow attributes debt to caller and sends USDC to receiver; borrowFor needs existing owner delegate approval, not ERC20 allowance. repayFor can fund another owner without delegation. repay(0)/repayFor(0,owner) mean full accrued outstanding debt; positive excess repayment reverts. Partial repayment can fail minimum-loan-size/oracle review. Borrow/post-collateral resets account cooldown; current manager source enforces 20-minute minimum hold on repayments and collateral-reducing actions, not a guaranteed immediately executable exit.

Exits are synchronous only when enough actual USDC cash is held; otherwise they revert, with no redemption queue or claim capability. Interest accrual occurs before ordinary calls; accounting includes vested interest, outstanding debt and protocol interest fee rather than treating wallet cash as totalAssets. No caller-set minimum shares/output, maximum assets/rate or deadline exists. Deposit/redeem round down; mint/withdraw round up; zero-result financial amounts revert.

Constructor binds CentralRegistry 0x1310f352f1389969Ece6741671c4B919523912fF, MarketManager 0xa6A2A92F126b79Ee0804845ee6B52899b4491093 and initial IRM 0x1622D77E311638C77779e6D9B212E3e7D73AaFB4. IRM, protocol interest fee, market parameters, listing, pauses, delegation indexes and dependencies can change; constructor IRM is not asserted to be current. No separate deposit/withdraw transaction fee is coded in these ordinary cToken paths; protocol fees affect interest/yield. Protocol interestFee is capped at6000 basis points (60% of accrued interest). MarketManager consults CentralRegistry per-account transfer-disable controls on collateral-reducing paths; enabled ABI metadata cannot bypass them.

No KYC credential/allowlist gate appears in reviewed ordinary cToken methods; that is not legal eligibility. Interface terms exclude US-located/organized/resident and listed sanctioned/restricted jurisdictions/persons, require adult capacity and prohibit location-obscuring technology. No bridge, flashloan, direct seizure callback, arbitrary multicall, PositionManager action payload or administration capability admitted. The separately reviewed fixed-interface liquidation entrypoints do not authorize those routes.

liquidate/liquidateExact spend caller raw six-decimal USDC and receive collateral cToken shares, not guaranteed underlying cash. Account addresses must be strictly ascending/unique and cannot equal caller. Exact debt arrays must match account count; max liquidation has no caller maximum-cost parameter, and neither variant has minimum seized output or deadline. MarketManager listing, liquidation eligibility/incentives, oracle values and pause rules apply; selected collateralToken is constrained to listed same-market cToken and fixed seize interface. Bad debt can be realized against lenders; no profitable liquidation, immediate underlying redemption or execution guarantee.

Prices and rounding can change; no user minimum shares/output, deadline or rate guarantee is present.

requestWithdraw fixes floor(asUSDF amount*current price/1e18) USDF payout, transfers that USDF to the fixed withdrawal vault, pulls caller asUSDF using allowance to the staking proxy, then burns it atomically. Any later yield does not increase this fixed request payout.

claimWithdraw accepts request numbers but enforces recorded receipt == msg.sender, positive payout and claimable. It deletes the request and asks the fixed vault to transfer USDF only to msg.sender; batch failure reverts atomically, including duplicate/unavailable IDs. Claim needs staking and vault unpaused, withdrawals enabled, staking TRANSFER_ROLE at the vault and vault cash. These current role/cash conditions are not attested.

BOT_ROLE must explicitly mark withdrawal requests claimable; source has no automatic elapsed-time claim entitlement or hardcoded queue deadline. Docs describe T+1 hour (about 2 hours), but this is operational guidance, not guaranteed source-enforced timing. Requests can remain unclaimable if processing is delayed. requestEmergencyWithdraw is separately admitted only as consumption of already enabled emergency eligibility; whitelist/role/configuration mutation remains excluded.

Selected staking source charges no mint/request/claim protocol fee and docs say asUSDF mint/withdraw no fees; gas is separate. USDF-to-USDT issuer redemption is a different product (documented fee/delay) and is not admitted. No yield, USDF backing/redemption or stable peg assurance is made.

USDF economic strategy relies on custodial/off-chain delta-neutral positions and funding fees, documented with Ceffu custody. Staking share accounting does not isolate this custody, strategy, centralized exchange, oracle or governance risk. No caller KYC/whitelist check appears on ordinary selected entrypoints, but app eligibility/jurisdiction and token restrictions remain.

requestEmergencyWithdraw requires emergencyWithdrawEnabled or caller already in emergencyWithdrawWhitelist, plus normal unpaused/withdraw-enabled checks, asUSDF allowance and pool USDF funding. It atomically fixes current-price payout, transfers USDF to fixed vault, pulls/burns caller shares and creates emergency=true, claimable=false caller receipt. Emergency flag does not make it immediate or bypass BOT_ROLE claimability processing; zero-rounded payout can strand a tiny burned request because claim requires positive receiveAmount. No emergency-enable, whitelist installation or operator privilege is added.

Exits are synchronous only when enough actual USDC cash is held; otherwise they revert, with no redemption queue or claim capability. Interest accrual occurs before ordinary calls; accounting includes vested interest, outstanding debt and protocol interest fee rather than treating wallet cash as totalAssets. No caller-set minimum shares/output, maximum assets/rate or deadline exists. Deposit/redeem round down; mint/withdraw round up; zero-result financial amounts revert.
